newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips edge lower, ending three-day surge.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips edge lower, ending three-day surge.

text.p: The Dow industrials slipped to a modest loss on Thursday, as a powerful rally in the blue chip average appeared to run out of steam.

The Dow fell 21 points to close unofficially at 6659. Before the loss, the index had jumped 288 points in just three days, a performance paralleled in recent history only by a 289-point surge in the two days after the Black Monday crash of 1987.
"The market seemed a little tired today," said Scott Bleier, chief investment strategist at Prime Charter Ltd.
